name: Nightmare Shard
summary: In the Wailing Caverns, Nightmare Shard carries a taint Falla Sagewind cannot ignore. She binds the Emerald Dream's pure, disturbed essence into it and sends it to senior druids with a warning meant for them alone.

sections.title: A Corrupted Vision
sections.body: Deep in the Wailing Caverns, Falla Sagewind examines a glowing shard. Its energy is darker than she expected. It reflects an unnatural affliction in the Emerald Dream, like a waking nightmare. Falla binds this tainted essence into Nightmare Shard and orders it carried without delay to the elder leaders of the Cenarion Circle.

sections.title: Hushed Omens
sections.body: Nightmare Shard reaches Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem on Elder Rise or Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus. Each looks into its depths with dismay. The vision unsettles them and confirms their quiet suspicions that something has gone terribly wrong within the Dream. Fearing public panic, the druids take the shard and warn the courier to speak no further of what they saw.

faq.answer: After examining a glowing fragment from the Wailing Caverns, Falla Sagewind entrusts Nightmare Shard to a courier. It holds the pure, disturbed essence of the Emerald Dream, with a dark, corruptive vision instead of peaceful nature energies.

aliases: where does the shard come from
faq.answer: Falla Sagewind examines a glowing fragment brought from the Wailing Caverns and recognizes its corruption. She charges the courier to carry the shard directly to senior druids for study.

faq.q: Why are the druid leaders so alarmed by it?
aliases: why does mathrengyl hide the shard
faq.answer: Looking into the shard, Hamuul Runetotem and Mathrengyl Bearwalker see a nightmare twisting the Emerald Dream. Fearing danger and public panic, they silence further discussion and keep the matter among senior members of the Cenarion Circle.

faq.q: Where does the shard need to be delivered?
aliases: who do i bring the shard to
faq.answer: Horde travelers are instructed to carry the shard to Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. Alliance travelers carry it to Mathrengyl Bearwalker within the Cenarion Circle in Darnassus.

angles.text: For druids, the shard reveals that corruption has reached the Emerald Dream. It confirms their concerns over Naralex's fate in the Wailing Caverns.
For Horde travelers, the shard brings grave news to Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. There, Hamuul Runetotem works to anchor the tauren's place in the wider Cenarion brotherhood.
